CLOUD DESIGN-REVISION seat (revision 4) for the combined CI design (group R10-CI-LAYOUT) of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor.
Inputs: revision 3 `probe/design-ci-rev3` (8bd4e68f) and round-4 review `probe/design-ci-review4` (21c86c18, REVIEW.md + ev/, verdict revise). Read both in full, plus judge.md, ci-autofix.md and gate-scoping.md from origin/main.
This is past three rounds, so make the minimum change: touch only what these items need, and say so for anything else you touch.
Owner ruling R-10, made under mandate after revision 3 was written: option B. pr-contract lists the open code-scanning alerts of step 4's matched analyses (refs/pull/N/merge at the carried code run); 4.3 step 5 and LAG_MAX are removed; U6 must show a planted python-only finding listed in --red, with its null control and the carried case.
Task: resolve R4-1 by writing 4.3, U6, section 9, R-10 and the R-10 section to option B. Resolve R4-2 by giving M-6, M-2's enabled half and final-control step 3 each a pre-merge driver that runs on a probe ref, and by naming the workflow_run trigger path as a post-merge check with its rollback. ALSO resolve R4-3, R4-4 and R4-5: this programme defers no finding. Add `## Round-4 item <id>` sections to RESPONSE.md.
Return: commit the revised DESIGN-P1.md, DESIGN-P2.md, measure/ and RESPONSE.md, and push ONLY `refs/heads/probe/design-ci-rev4`. No PRs, comments or workflow edits on real branches. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or refusal; report it.
